description: This file defines the DataTransform class responsible for sanitizing, filtering, and transforming data for the vtiger CRM web services API. It includes methods for processing data rows, handling references, owner fields, date and currency fields, and preparing data for database operations.

classes.name: DataTransform
classes.description: A class providing static methods for data sanitization, filtering, and transformation in vtiger CRM web services interactions.

methods.name: sanitizeDataWithColumn
methods.description: Sanitizes a data row by mapping columns to fields and applying data sanitization.

methods.name: sanitizeDataWithCountColumn
methods.description: Handles sanitization for count query results, setting a count field.

methods.name: filterAndSanitize
methods.description: Filters all columns for a row and sanitizes the data.

methods.name: sanitizeData
methods.description: Performs comprehensive sanitization on data, including references, owner fields, and standard fields.

methods.name: sanitizeForInsert
methods.description: Prepares data for insertion, handling specific entity types like emails and events, including setting reminders and handling references.

methods.name: filterAllColumns
methods.description: Filters relevant columns based on metadata for the data row.

methods.name: sanitizeFields
methods.description: Sanitizes fields, handling ID conversion, and decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: sanitizeReferences
methods.description: Sanitizes reference fields, ensuring linked entities exist and converting IDs.

methods.name: sanitizeOwnerFields
methods.description: Sanitizes owner-related fields, converting owner IDs appropriately.

methods.name: sanitizeDateFieldsForInsert
methods.description: Formats date fields to display format based on current user.

methods.name: sanitizeCurrencyFieldsForInsert
methods.description: Converts currency fields to user format based on current user settings.
